     : forall (R : reals.Real.type) (G : Kernel.MathCompCouplingGluing R)
         (E F : Type -> Type) (A : Type)
         (h : forall X : Type, E X -> PTreeDefinition.ptree F (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) X),
       @MDP.mdp_handler E F (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R)
         (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R) (@Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasureCoreLaws R G)
         (NativeLaws.MathCompNativeMixedMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticOmega R) h A ->
       @Interp.Guarded.guarded_handler E F (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R)
         (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R)
         (NativeLaws.MathCompNativeMixedMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticOmega R) h ->
       forall t u : PTreeDefinition.ptree E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) A,
       @MDPFragment.mdp_state E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R)
         (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R) (@Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasureCoreLaws R G)
         (NativeLaws.MathCompNativeMixedMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticOmega R) A t ->
       @MDPFragment.mdp_state E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R)
         (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R) (@Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasureCoreLaws R G)
         (NativeLaws.MathCompNativeMixedMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticOmega R) A u ->
       @TreeTransitionBisim.tree_trans_bisim E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R)
         (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R)
         (@Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasureCoreLaws R G)
         (NativeLaws.MathCompNativeMixedMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticOmega R) A A
         (@eq A) t u ->
       @TreeTransitionBisim.tree_trans_bisim F (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R)
         (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R)
         (@Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasureCoreLaws R G)
         (NativeLaws.MathCompNativeMixedMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticOmega R) A A
         (@eq A) (@PTreeDefinition.PTree.interp E F (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) h A t)
         (@PTreeDefinition.PTree.interp E F (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) h A u)
direct.assumptions:
Axioms:
RelationalChoice.relational_choice :
  forall (A B : Type) (R : A -> B -> Prop),
  (forall x : A, exists y : B, R x y) ->
  exists R' : A -> B -> Prop, @subrelation A B R' R /\ (forall x : A, exists ! y : B, R' x y)
boolp.propositional_extensionality : forall P Q : Prop, P <-> Q -> P = Q
boolp.functional_extensionality_dep :
  forall (A : Type) (B : A -> Type) (f g : forall x : A, B x), (forall x : A, f x = g x) -> f = g
Eqdep.Eq_rect_eq.eq_rect_eq :
  forall (U : Type) (p : U) (Q : U -> Type) (x : Q p) (h : p = p), x = @eq_rect U p Q x p h
ClassicalUniqueChoice.dependent_unique_choice :
  forall (A : Type) (B : A -> Type) (R : forall x : A, B x -> Prop),
  (forall x : A, exists ! y : B x, R x y) -> exists f : forall x : A, B x, forall x : A, R x (f x)
boolp.constructive_indefinite_description :
  forall (A : Type) (P : A -> Prop), (exists x : A, P x) -> {x : A | P x}
Classical_Prop.classic : forall P : Prop, P \/ ~ P
